name: The Lost Tools
summary: Blackrock fire has sunk Foreman Oslow's tools in Lake Everstill. Lakeshire is under pressure, and its builders need the shipment from Goldshire to repair the Great Bridge.

sections.title: A Delivery Gone Awry
sections.body: The Great Bridge no longer joins Lakeshire to Elwynn Forest. A replacement shipment of stonework and carpentry tools came overland from Goldshire, but the wagons could not reach town. So the crew loaded the supplies into a rowboat to cross Lake Everstill. A Blackrock orc catapult struck the boat. It broke apart, and Oslow's heavy ironbound toolbox sank to the lake floor.

sections.title: Hazards of the Deep
sections.body: Lake Everstill is dangerous below the surface. Aggressive murloc tribes prowl the shallows, while predatory threshers hunt in the murky depths. Foreman Oslow needs his tools to resume repairs on the bridge. Without them, Lakeshire risks falling further into ruin.

faq.q: Why were the tools sent by boat in the first place?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs destroyed a large span of the stone bridge over Lake Everstill, leaving supply wagons from Goldshire unable to reach Lakeshire. The crew unloaded the tools and tried to ferry them across the water.
A catapult projectile struck the transport boat as it crossed Lake Everstill. Blackrock orcs fired from the surrounding heights, and the boat sank with its cargo.
Foreman Oslow is Lakeshire's chief builder and overseer. He is responsible for public works and civil maintenance, with rebuilding the ruined bridge his most urgent work.

faq.q: What threats are in Lake Everstill?
faq.answer: Hostile murloc tribes patrol the shores and ruins. Vicious, carnivorous lake threshers hunt in open water and the deeper depths.

faq.q: Why does Lakeshire need these tools so badly?
faq.answer: Lakeshire is under siege and cut off from immediate reinforcements and regular shipments. Without heavy tools, Oslow cannot rebuild the bridge or repair the defenses needed against attacking orcs and gnolls.

faq.q: Where does the quest lead next?
faq.answer: After his toolbox is recovered, Foreman Oslow asks travelers to gather the raw building materials needed to repair the Great Bridge in The Everstill Bridge.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you help Lakeshire hold the eastern frontier against the Blackrock clan. Civilian builders need their equipment to maintain the Kingdom of Stormwind's defenses.
As a blacksmith, you know quality tools are hard to forge under siege. Recovering the specialized smithing and construction implements sent from Goldshire matters to the town.
